How many Business Analyst jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 2,649 open Business Analyst jobs in the United States as of November 25, 2026.

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $85,000–$130,000 a year, based on 511 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.
